method: run-owned saved pages created with wikidot.py as the sandbox account, fetched anonymously (http), left in place as muse-probe-ts-*; pages carry no tags, so [[iftags +zz-no-such-tag]] is false (body hidden). Joined controls without gates via the PagePreview route, each rendered twice with identical output. Rendered values are page-content inner HTML with entities decoded and whitespace normalized.
